SELECT t.name AS tenant_name,
       CAST(date_trunc('month', wd.created_at) AS date) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS total_sync_deliveries,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wd.status IN ('pending','retrying')) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pending_or_retrying_rate_pct
FROM webhook_deliveries wd
JOIN webhooks w ON w.id = wd.webhook_id
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = wd.tenant_id
WHERE t.name IN ('Brennquell Kaffee','Cragsley Outfitters','Ampfeld Elektronik','Marrowby & Vane')
  AND wd.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND wd.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND (w.name ILIKE '%ERP%sync%' OR w.name ILIKE '%WMS%sync%' OR w.name ILIKE '%ACCOUNTING%sync%')
GROUP BY t.name, date_trunc('month', wd.created_at)
ORDER BY t.name ASC, date_trunc('month', wd.created_at) ASC
note: Month is printed as the first calendar day of that month (date type) since TO_CHAR isn't available in this engine; sync-webhook matching uses ILIKE '%ERP%sync%'/'%WMS%sync%'/'%ACCOUNTING%sync%' on webhooks.name to catch close name variants, consistent with the prior sync-webhook report's approach.
